user.title: Connect your Resideo thermostat
user.description: Use the Resideo (formerly Honeywell Home) account that controls your Lyric T6. No developer account or SmartThings account is needed.

account.title: Sign in to Resideo
account.description: Use your normal Resideo app account. Your password is used for sign-in and is not saved. Country is the two-letter code used in the app, for example RO or GB. If Resideo needs an additional browser step, setup will continue with browser sign-in.

browser.title: Sign in with Resideo in your browser
browser.description: Open [Resideo sign-in]({login_url}) in a desktop browser. In that same tab, open Developer Tools → Network and enable Preserve log before signing in. Complete any Resideo prompts, then copy the full Request URL beginning com.honeywell.acs.lyric.enterprise://oauth2redirect into the field below. The URL may include a slash before the question mark; both forms are accepted. The browser may report that it cannot open the app; that is expected. Use only the link from this setup attempt.

refresh_token.title: Use an existing Resideo app refresh token
refresh_token.description: Advanced: this must be a token from the legacy Resideo Android app client, not First Alert or the developer API. Never share it in chat or logs. Normal account or browser sign-in is recommended.

error.invalid_auth: Resideo rejected the login or authorization. Check your account in the Resideo app, or sign in again using a fresh browser link.
error.interaction_required: Resideo needs a browser step to finish sign-in. Continue using the Resideo sign-in link below, even if your account already works in the official app.
error.invalid_callback: The redirect URL is incomplete or belongs to another setup attempt. Copy the full Request URL after signing in with the link shown in this form.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Resideo. Check the connection and try again later.
error.rate_limited: Resideo is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes before retrying.
error.unexpected_response: Resideo returned an unexpected response. Download the integration diagnostics if available and report the issue.

abort.already_configured: This Resideo account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Your Resideo authorization has been renewed.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Resideo account as the existing integration.
abort.no_thermostats: Sign-in succeeded, but this legacy Resideo account returned no supported thermostats. Complete account migration or updated terms in the Resideo app first. First Alert / Titan-only devices are not supported by this integration.

init.title: Resideo settings
init.description: One account refresh is shared by all thermostats. Manual temperature changes use the selected hold unless a permanent hold is already active.

boost_hot_water.name: Boost hot water
boost_hot_water.description: Start a timed hot-water boost for the selected duration.

cancel_hot_water_boost.name: Cancel hot-water boost
cancel_hot_water_boost.description: Send the app's temporary hot-water off command. Choose Follow schedule to explicitly resume the schedule.
